hero.sub: Connect your exchange APIs. Mozi AutoArb monitors crypto and tokenized US stock arbitrage 24/7 and auto-executes Cash & Carry, cross-exchange spread, and basis strategies.

howItWorks.title: Start auto arb in four steps
howItWorks.sub: From API connection to your first arb profit — under 15 minutes

steps.title: Connect API keys
steps.desc: Create trade-only API keys (no withdrawals) on your exchange and submit them over an encrypted channel. Keys are stored with AES-256; servers never see plaintext.

steps.title: Configure strategy
steps.desc: Pick arb type, assets, capital, and risk controls. Historical data helps estimate return ranges and set realistic expectations.

steps.title: Paper-trade validation
steps.desc: New strategies run a mandatory 72-hour paper period to validate signals and risk triggers with zero capital at risk.

steps.title: Go live
steps.desc: After paper trading passes, start live with a small cap (default ≤20% of your limit). Size ramps up automatically as performance stabilizes.

strategies.title: Three proven arbitrage strategies
strategies.sub: Each has its own risk model and backtest history

funding.name: Funding arb (Cash & Carry)
funding.desc: Long spot + short perp for near-neutral exposure while collecting funding. Hyperliquid settles hourly — strong annualized effect.

spread.name: Cross-exchange spread
spread.desc: Monitor the same asset across venues — buy low, sell high. Execution window 1–30 min; net spread after fees is profit.

basis.name: Basis arb
basis.desc: Trade perp vs spot basis: long spot + short perp to earn basis convergence and funding together.

security.title: Fund safety comes first
security.sub: We cannot withdraw your assets — only execute trades you authorize

items.title: Trade-only API keys — withdrawals disabled
items.desc: We require withdrawal permission off on exchange APIs. Even if keys leak, attackers cannot move funds — only trade.

items.title: AES-256 + HSM encryption
items.desc: Keys are encrypted with your account password on submit, then HSM-encrypted at rest. The database stores ciphertext only.

items.title: Fixed IP whitelist
items.desc: Execution servers use fixed egress IPs. Set an exchange IP whitelist so unknown callers are rejected.

items.title: Real-time anomaly detection + circuit breaker
items.desc: Every trade passes slippage, position, and margin checks. Anomalies halt the strategy and notify you immediately.

threatModel.desc: No withdrawals + IP whitelist — attacker cannot profit

edgeCases.title: We plan for what can go wrong

exec: Abort if slippage exceeds threshold (default 0.15%) — logged as missed opportunity
Hold open leg, wait to complete or flatten on timeout to avoid one-sided exposure
Redis distributed lock — one opportunity per account executes once
Idempotent retry with order ID — no duplicate orders
Retry transient errors; pause strategy and alert on permanent errors
risk: Alert at 50%, auto de-risk at 40%, force close at 30%
Pause new entries after 3 negative settlements; notify user
Cut size to 50%, alert, restore when basis normalizes
No new entries for the day; existing positions maintained
Order-book depth check — skip entry if below threshold
ops: Detect announcements, pause early, verify after maintenance
Stop related strategies immediately and alert for re-auth
Adaptive queue — prioritize stops, delay new entries
State persisted in Redis — strategies resume without duplicate opens
NTP sync + server timestamp validation for funding settlement timing

funding.title: If funding turns sharply negative
funding.outcome: After 3 consecutive negative settlements, new entries pause automatically. Existing positions are kept and you are notified — no forced close.

funding.title: If the exchange goes down
funding.outcome: Position state is persisted. After reconnect, positions are reconciled before deciding whether to continue — no blind re-entry.

funding.title: If spot leg fills but perp leg fails
funding.outcome: Immediately market-close the filled spot leg. Slippage from the rollback is reflected in net strategy P&L.

funding.title: If margin ratio falls below 35% liquidation line
funding.outcome: Forced de-risking triggers to protect principal, with immediate alert.

spread.title: If spread vanishes at order time
spread.outcome: Abort if slippage exceeds tolerance — logged as missed opportunity, no forced fill.

spread.title: If only one exchange leg fills
spread.outcome: If the other leg is not confirmed within 1.5s, immediately market-rollback the filled leg to avoid overnight naked exposure.

spread.title: If an exchange API is rate-limited
spread.outcome: Adaptive backoff retry; skip this opportunity after max retries without affecting other strategies.

basis.title: If basis expands beyond 1.5%
basis.outcome: Auto cut size to 50%, wait for basis to converge before restoring — no hard carry of exposure.

basis.title: If funding turns negative during hold
basis.outcome: Counted as actual daily loss; if daily loss limit hits, no new entries for the day.

basis.title: If scheduled exchange maintenance
basis.outcome: Detect maintenance announcements early, pause strategy, verify connection after maintenance before resuming.

tooltips.slippage: Slippage: difference between expected and actual fill price, often due to thin depth or volatility.

tooltips.funding: Funding rate: periodic payment between longs and shorts on perps to anchor price to spot. When positive, longs pay shorts.
tooltips.basis: Basis: gap between perp and spot. Basis arb goes long spot + short perp to earn convergence.
tooltips.marginRatio: Margin ratio: equity vs required margin. Lower ratio = closer to liquidation.
tooltips.slippage: Slippage: difference between expected and actual fill price.
tooltips.leverage: Leverage: control larger perp exposure with less margin. Higher leverage = larger margin swings.
